name: vnd-ai-sdlc
description: VNDIRECT AI-SDLC harness, framework-agnostic layer: /harness-init bootstraps the harness into any repo by detecting its real toolchain and layout; architect/reviewer/security agents; process commands (plan-feature, spec, adr, review, security-review, pr, status, agent-metrics, update-memory, abort); a governed skill lifecycle (skill-new, skill-submit, skill-approve, skill-sync); and a self-contained bundled MCP server exposing Confluence, Jira, GitHub and Claude Code trigger tools. Pair with vnd-ai-sdlc-stockbook for Flutter/GitLab specifics.
